conditions: VU Notarieel Recht, Dutch three-year bachelor, Fall-2026 entrant; no formal route (OER10.2). The 2026–2027 OER adopted 4 June 2026, PDF generated 19 June 2026, governs. Older-cohort tables and their Capita Selecta, BedrijfseconomieII, Case Studies Belastingrecht and EncyclopediaII must not be mixed into this plan. comparability: The workbook supports genuine comparative legal study: law and society, human rights, criminal justice, public international law, comparative constitutional/administrative law, private law and transnational business law. All eight law-focused courses together account for60EC in the proposed180EC programme. Principles of Private Law studies selected property, tort and contract principles primarily through Germany, France, England, China and the USA; Transnational Business Law addresses cross-border transactions, contracts, trade, intellectual property, investment, digital commerce and arbitration. Neither supplies the sustained Dutch property, inheritance, family/relationship-property, company and tax-law progression, notarial office law, civil/insolvency procedure and integrated Dutch legal research that define VU Notarieel Recht (OER10.3). The remaining120EC provide business, economics, statistics, rhetoric, negotiation and personal development. Accounting can support the business-economics element; negotiation and rhetoric can support communication. Public Economics studies taxation as economic policy, not Dutch tax doctrine; general research methods and market research do not supply the required independent notarial legal research. These are useful contributions but cannot replace the missing defining substance. A broader law/business/negotiation programme is a different target. The no-match conclusion concerns academic substance and weight, independently of professional eligibility or automatic master admission. A workbook-wide title/discipline/profile search found no additional notarial/property/inheritance/family/tax-law sequence from which to reconstruct a defensible response.
